name: comp-283
title: Warning Alert Banner
description: A dismissible warning banner. An amber triangle sits beside a short message, a link with an arrow, and an X; clicking the X removes the banner entirely.
use: A short warning should sit above content with a direct link to resolve it and a way to dismiss.
avoid: Message, link label and destination are fixed in the file, and there is only the amber warning tone.
a11y: The close button has a proper name and both actions focus normally, but the bar has no live-region role. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle with a thin border and a soft drop shadow holds an amber triangle warning icon, one line of pale text, a bold Fix it link with a right arrow, and a small grey close cross at the right edge.
behaves: Hovering the cross brightens it, hovering the link nudges its arrow forward, and clicking the cross removes the whole banner, leaving the stage empty until the demo brings it back.
customise: The message, link wording and where it points live in the file; onClose is the only prop, and the amber icon colour is fixed.
weight: light: One bordered bar with an icon, a link and a button.
